comment: Synthetic text for #590 item 7. Each line runs through output masking on its own and in the text shapes tools print around a line (tests/output-text-shapes.sh). %R% becomes a random letter-and-digit run each test, %H% a random 40-digit hex run, %W% a short human password and %G% the marker the bundled mock scanner reports, all assembled at run time so no literal here looks like a credential. A `mask` line comes back as `masked`; a `keep` line is left untouched. `differences` lists the cells where a shape is known to give another verdict than the plain line, each with its reason; a listed cell that matches the plain line again fails too, so the list stays current.

lines.label: prose
lines.line: The password must be at least 8 characters long.

differences.reason: #578: a path with no line number in front (`path:`) is not a line locator, so the field is not at the start of its line and its exemption does not apply
